rules.title: Annual Rent Increase Limit for Rent-Controlled Units
rules.requirement: The annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units is limited to 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain: If your unit is rent-controlled in San Francisco, your landlord can only increase your rent by up to 1.6% between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su unidad está bajo control de rentas en San Francisco, su arrendador solo puede aumentar su renta hasta un 1.6% entre el 1 de marzo de 2026 y el 28 de febrero de 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
